people.name: Jonah
people.line: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh

people.name: Nineveh
people.line: The capital of Assyria, known for its wickedness and repentance

translations.web: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”
translations.bsb: On the first day of his journey, Jonah set out into the city and proclaimed, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned!”
translations.kjv: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
translations.asv: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
